items.item_text: California Licensed Pharmacy Technician
California Pharmacy Technician Certification (PTCB)
Minimum education satisfied through attainment of the required licensure/certification
Experience of practices and protocols related to medical office procedures, (i.e., medical terminology, appointments, medical records, insurance verifications, cashiering, billing, etc.)
Pharmacy Technician experience in infusion setting
Recent work experience as a Pharmacy Technician
Patient assistance program experience
Recent experience submitting prior authorizations or significant involvement in the prior authorization process for medication coverage
Prior authorization submission experience
Experience in MS Office suite: Word, Excel, Power Point and Access
Experience in following established protocol and keeping accurate records and paying close attention to details

The Pharmacy Technician 3 is responsible for gathering information from medical records and other sources as required to process prior authorization requests, conduct benefit checks, scheduling, and assist with patient assistance program enrollment. Communicates on status of requests with requesting parties and works towards resolution of more cumbersome authorization requests. Maintains database of activities to document workload and impact on patient outcomes. Executes on site of care optimization strategies as determined by system leadership. Gathers information and helps develop workflows to prevent denials. #CA-DS
65% - Facilitates Medical Benefit Authorization and Medication access
30% - Data Analysis and Quality Improvement/ Assurance
5% - Other duties as assigned
Familiarity with hospital, infusion center, names and locations of patient care areas
Ability to process prior authorizations
Knowledge in new patient scheduling and hospital, department, and university policies and procedures related to infusion
Knowledge of current California Pharmacy Law
Excellent customer service skills and communications both orally and in writing

Problem solving skills to independently recognize and define a problem and identify the resources available to help solve the problem, create and implement solutions, and follow through to ensure the problem is resolved to the satisfaction of all parties.
